pattern: join two same-shape tables on an id, compute a delta, rank top five, dropouts fall out via inner join
question: rank the top 5 by how much their situp count went up since baseline, best improver first
gold_sql: SELECT b."Child Name", e."Sit Ups" - b."Sit Ups" AS situps_improvement FROM sportathon_baseline AS b JOIN sportathon_endline AS e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID" ORDER BY situps_improvement DESC, b."Child Name" LIMIT 5
sql_duckdb: SELECT b."Child ID", b."Child Name", e."Sit Ups" - b."Sit Ups" AS "Sit Up Improvement" FROM "sportathon_baseline" AS b JOIN "sportathon_endline" AS e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID" WHERE NOT b."Sit Ups" IS NULL AND NOT e."Sit Ups" IS NULL ORDER BY "Sit Up Improvement" DESC LIMIT 5

rank the top 5 by how much their situp count went up since baseline, best improver first
attempts.response:
SELECT
  b."Child ID",
  b."Child Name",
  e."Sit Ups" - b."Sit Ups" AS "Sit Up Improvement"
FROM "sportathon_baseline" b
JOIN "sportathon_endline" e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID"
WHERE b."Sit Ups" IS NOT NULL AND e."Sit Ups" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY "Sit Up Improvement" DESC
LIMIT 5;
